import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def getseq(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=90); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])

PANEL={"Afum_erg13A":"Q4WBQ3","Afum_erg13B":"Q4WXT8","Anig_A2QN35":"A2QN35","Anig_A2QD99":"A2QD99",
 "Aory_Q2UKZ2":"Q2UKZ2","Aory_Q2TWN5":"Q2TWN5","Afla_MZ71":"A0A7U2MZ71","Afla_QRY5":"A0A7U2QRY5",
 "Prub_B6GZ46":"B6GZ46","Prub_B6HCE6":"B6HCE6","Anid_Q5B3F7":"Q5B3F7","Tmar_B6Q1E0":"B6Q1E0",
 "Scer_ERG13":"P54839","Ncra_Q1K5Z3":"Q1K5Z3","Spom_hcs1":"P54874","Hsap_HMGCS1":"Q01581"}
S={k:getseq(v) for k,v in PANEL.items()}

AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
b62=np.array([
[4,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-1,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,0,-3,-2,0],
[-1,5,0,-2,-3,1,0,-2,0,-3,-2,2,-1,-3,-2,-1,-1,-3,-2,-3],
[-2,0,6,1,-3,0,0,0,1,-3,-3,0,-2,-3,-2,1,0,-4,-2,-3],
[-2,-2,1,6,-3,0,2,-1,-1,-3,-4,-1,-3,-3,-1,0,-1,-4,-3,-3],
[0,-3,-3,-3,9,-3,-4,-3,-3,-1,-1,-3,-1,-2,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1],
[-1,1,0,0,-3,5,2,-2,0,-3,-2,1,0,-3,-1,0,-1,-2,-1,-2],
[-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5,-2,0,-3,-3,1,-2,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],
[0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6,-2,-4,-4,-2,-3,-3,-2,0,-2,-2,-3,-3],
[-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8,-3,-3,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-2,-2,2,-3],
[-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4,2,-3,1,0,-3,-2,-1,-3,-1,3],
[-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4,-2,2,0,-3,-2,-1,-2,-1,1],
[-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5,-1,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],
[-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,1],
[-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6,-4,-2,-2,1,3,-1],
[-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7,-1,-1,-4,-3,-2],
[1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4,1,-3,-2,-2],
[0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5,-2,-2,0],
[-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11,2,-3],
[-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7,-1],
[0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4]],dtype=float)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s])

GO,GE=-11.0,-1.0
NEG=-1e9
def align(s1,s2):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    M[0,0]=0.0
    X[1:,0]=GO+GE*np.arange(n); Y[0,1:]=GO+GE*np.arange(m)
    jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        row=np.where(e1[i-1]>=0, b62[e1[i-1]][np.clip(e2,0,19)], -1.0)
        row=np.where(e2>=0,row,-1.0)
        M[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1]),Y[i-1,:-1])+row
        X[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,1:]+GO,X[i-1,1:]+GE),Y[i-1,1:]+GO)
        V=np.maximum(M[i,:-1]+GO,X[i,:-1]+GO)        # open from col j-1
        cand=V-GE*jj[:-1]
        Y[i,1:]=GE*jj[1:]+np.maximum.accumulate(cand)
        # Y extending Y is already captured by the prefix-max formulation
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1])
            prev=[M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]];st=int(np.argmax(prev));i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-')
            prev=[M[i-1,j]+GO,X[i-1,j]+GE,Y[i-1,j]+GO];st=int(np.argmax(prev));i-=1
        else:
            a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1])
            prev=[M[i,j-1]+GO,X[i,j-1]+GO,Y[i,j-1]+GE];st=int(np.argmax(prev));j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

names=list(S); n=len(names); ID=np.eye(n)*100
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        A1,A2=align(S[names[i]],S[names[j]])
        al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A1,A2) if x!='-' and y!='-')
        idn=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A1,A2) if x==y and x!='-')
        ID[i,j]=ID[j,i]=100*idn/al
idf=pd.DataFrame(ID.round(1),index=names,columns=names)
pd.set_option("display.width",320)
print("PERCENT IDENTITY MATRIX (global NW, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1)")
print(idf.to_string())

# Neighbour joining
D=(100-ID).astype(float); np.fill_diagonal(D,0.0)
nodes=names[:]; Dm=D.copy()
while len(nodes)>2:
    k=len(nodes); r=Dm.sum(axis=1)/(k-2)
    Q=Dm-r[:,None]-r[None,:]; np.fill_diagonal(Q,np.inf)
    i,j=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(Q),Q.shape)
    if i>j: i,j=j,i
    new=f"({nodes[i]},{nodes[j]})"
    nr=0.5*(Dm[i,:]+Dm[j,:]-Dm[i,j])
    keep=[m for m in range(k) if m not in (i,j)]
    Dn=np.zeros((len(keep)+1,len(keep)+1)); Dn[:-1,:-1]=Dm[np.ix_(keep,keep)]
    Dn[-1,:-1]=nr[keep]; Dn[:-1,-1]=nr[keep]
    nodes=[nodes[m] for m in keep]+[new]; Dm=Dn
print("\nNEIGHBOUR-JOINING TOPOLOGY (Newick):")
print(f"({nodes[0]},{nodes[1]});")

print("\nOrthology test: nearest non-A.fumigatus neighbour of each paralogue")
for p in ["Afum_erg13A","Afum_erg13B"]:
    s=idf.loc[p].drop([p,"Afum_erg13A","Afum_erg13B"],errors="ignore").sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(f" {p}: ", ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in s.head(6).items()))
print("\n erg13A vs erg13B identity:", idf.loc["Afum_erg13A","Afum_erg13B"])
print(" identity to A. nidulans single copy: erg13A=%.1f  erg13B=%.1f"%(idf.loc['Afum_erg13A','Anid_Q5B3F7'],idf.loc['Afum_erg13B','Anid_Q5B3F7']))
print(" identity to S. cerevisiae ERG13:     erg13A=%.1f  erg13B=%.1f"%(idf.loc['Afum_erg13A','Scer_ERG13'],idf.loc['Afum_erg13B','Scer_ERG13']))
print(" identity to human HMGCS1:            erg13A=%.1f  erg13B=%.1f"%(idf.loc['Afum_erg13A','Hsap_HMGCS1'],idf.loc['Afum_erg13B','Hsap_HMGCS1']))

# Figure: heatmap + divergence comparison
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(17,7),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1]})
im=axes[0].imshow(ID,cmap="viridis",vmin=40,vmax=100)
axes[0].set_xticks(range(n)); axes[0].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_yticks(range(n)); axes[0].set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        axes[0].text(j,i,f"{ID[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=6,
                     color="white" if ID[i,j]<80 else "black")
axes[0].set_title("Pairwise percent identity, fungal HMG-CoA synthases",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=axes[0],fraction=0.046,label="% identity")

outg=["Anid_Q5B3F7","Tmar_B6Q1E0","Scer_ERG13","Ncra_Q1K5Z3","Spom_hcs1","Hsap_HMGCS1"]
xa=[idf.loc["Afum_erg13A",o] for o in outg]; xb=[idf.loc["Afum_erg13B",o] for o in outg]
w=0.38; pos=np.arange(len(outg))
axes[1].barh(pos-w/2,xa,w,label="erg13A (Q4WBQ3)",color="#c0504d")
axes[1].barh(pos+w/2,xb,w,label="erg13B (Q4WXT8)",color="#4f81bd")
for p_,v in zip(pos-w/2,xa): axes[1].text(v+0.4,p_,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
for p_,v in zip(pos+w/2,xb): axes[1].text(v+0.4,p_,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_yticks(pos); axes[1].set_yticklabels(outg,fontsize=9); axes[1].invert_yaxis()
axes[1].set_xlabel("% identity to A. fumigatus paralogue"); axes[1].set_xlim(40,75)
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8); axes[1].set_title("erg13B is consistently closer to single-copy\nand characterised HMG-CoA synthases",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
